name: @ag/functions
description: Ambika Group CRM server part. On the free plan (D-51) it runs as Netlify Functions (netlify/functions re-exports src/netlify.ts): one handler runs the shared core commands inside a Firestore transaction, plus Setup, sample data, the website enquiry link and the nightly clean-up. src/callables.ts is the same work as Cloud Functions, kept for a paid plan.
